description: Register a domain and pay from prepaid balance in one call. For .eu, send eu_eligible: true and a registrant object with an EU or EEA country.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

registrant.description: Required for .eu: name, address, city, postcode, country, phone, email.

name: buy_with_balance
title: Buy a domain with balance
